name: Night Sky
author: kairos
description: All-sky constellation chart for your location, with sunrise and sunset times. Stars, planets and the Moon are computed offline from bundled data.

barWidget.description: Constellations overhead right now, plus sunrise and sunset

schema.label: Faintest magnitude shown
schema.description: Higher shows more, fainter stars. 5 is about what a good suburban sky reveals; 6 is a dark rural site. Redraws locally - never makes a network request.

schema.label: Constellation lines
schema.description: The stick figures joining each constellation's stars.

schema.label: Constellation names
schema.description: Labels the larger constellations currently above the horizon.

schema.label: Planets and Moon
schema.description: Mercury through Saturn at their real positions, and the Moon drawn at its current phase.

schema.label: Milky Way band
schema.description: A faint band showing where the galaxy crosses the sky.

schema.label: Time format
schema.description: How sunrise, sunset and the bar's next-event time are written.
